name: Intune Log Collector
description: Intune Log Collector is an Azure-based solution that collects logs from Intune-managed devices, including files, directories, and event logs. It deploys a Function App, Storage Account, and Key Vault, with the Remediation script driving log collection per LogsGatherRules.json and uploading a compressed archive to the logs container. Deployments support Azure Template Spec (Bicep/ARM) or direct ARM templates, with optional UI and post-deployment steps.
keywords: how to gather logs from managed devices
author: Nickolaj Andersen

securityCheck.aiSummary: Overall assessment: The code implements legitimate Intune/Graph-based device authentication and blob/log handling patterns. Notable security considerations include potential data exposure through blob content returned in responses and logs, plus SAS token distribution that could be misused if leaked. No obfuscated or remote-code execution patterns detected. Recommend tightening logging of sensitive fields, validating blob content exposure boundaries, and ensuring SAS tokens are minimally scoped and time-bounded.

noDataExfiltration.reason: Generates and returns a SAS token with read/write access for the storage container using a stored policy. If leaked, the token could allow unauthorized access to logs. Risk mitigations include tightening token scope, reducing lifetime, and avoiding returning tokens in API responses unless required.
